paite: Huan Jakob in atapate asamkhawm a, hichibang in agen hi: "Ni nanungte a na tung ua thil hong tung dingte ka hon hilhtheihna ding in hong kikhawm un.
heading: Jakob Thu Nanung
english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

paite: "Nou Jakob tapate aw, hong kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; na pa uh Israel thu ngai un.
english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

paite: "Reuben, nang ka tapa masa, ka thilhihtheihna, ka hatna gah masapen na hi. Sanpenna leh thuneihpenna nang a ahi.
english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

paite: Himahleh tui bang a kip lou na hi, tungnunpenna na nei kei ding; na pa lupnapi a na kal ziak in. Huai ah ka lupna a kal in na hihbuah hi.
english: Boiling over as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

paite: "Simeon leh Levi unau ahi ua, anamsaute uh sisan suahna vanzat ahi.
english: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

paite: Ka kha aw, nang zaw akikupna uah va kigolh ke'n. Ka thupina, nang zaw akikhopna uah tel ke'n. Aheh un mi athat ua, agenhak un bawngtal thagui asattat uhi.
english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

paite: Ahehna un hamsia dong hen, hangsantak ahi ngal ua. Athangpaihna un leng hamsia dong hen, hinsetak ahi ngal ua. Jakob ah amaute ka kikhensak ding a, Israel ah ka hihdalh ding hi.
english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

paite: "Judah, nang na unaute'n ahon phat ding uh. Na doute ngawng ah na khut na nga ding a; na ma ah na tapate akun ding uh.
english: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

paite: Judah humpinelkai nou ahi. Ka tapa, na sa keih na paitouhsanta. Na kun a, humpinelkai bang in na bok a, humpinelkainu bang in na kualsuk hi. Kua'n ahia hon thousak ngam ding?
english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

paite: Judah a kipan lalchiang amang kei ding, vaihawmpa chiang akhekal a kipan amang kei ding. Shiloh ahong pai mateng; mite'n ama thu amang ding uhi.
english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.

paite: Grepgui ah asakolnou akhih ding a, asabiltungnou grepgui hoih chi ah akhih ding hi. Apuansilhte uain in asawp ding a, grep sisan in apuan asawp lai ding hi.
english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

paite: Amitte uain in asan ding ua, ahate nawitui in angou ding uhi.
english: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

paite: "Tuipi gei ah Zebulun ateng ding a, longkhawlna luipiau ahi ding a; agamgi Zidon ah ahi ding.
english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

paite: "Issakar zaw sabiltung hattak ahi a, van-gik nih kal a kual ahi.
english: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

paite: Khawl hoih in athei a, gam leng hoih in athei; huchi in van po ding in aliangzang aniamsak a, phutluih nasem in sikha in ahong omta hi.
english: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

paite: "Dan in Israel nam lak a khat bang in amite vai ahawmsak ding.
english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

paite: Dan ahihleh lamlian gei a gul, lampi a gulgial, atung a tuangmi thalkiak ek khop a sakol khetul tu nakpa ahi ding.
english: Dan will be a serpent in the way, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

paite: "AW TOUPA, na hotdamna ka ngak gige hi.
english: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

paite: "Gal in Gad asual ding a, himahleh ama'n akhetul lam uah amaute asual zaw ding hi.
english: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

paite: "Asher, anek ahoih ding a, kumpi nekte apiangsak ding hi.
english: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will yield royal dainties.

paite: "Naphtali, zukpi khah ahi. Thuhoih pipi agen zel hi.
english: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

paite: "Joseph hiang gah nuamtak ahi, tuikhuk kiang a hiang gah nuamtak; ahiang nawnsawnte'n baang atuam uhi.
english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

paite: Thalkap mite'n nakpitak in amah ahihgenthei ua, akap ua, asimmoh uhi.
english: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecute him:

paite: Himahleh, amah thalpeu khauhtak in a-om gige a, abanthate Jakob' Pathian Mihatpa hatsak; belamchingmi, Israel suangpi a pan ahi.
english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

paite: Na pa Pathian, nang hon panpih dingpa, Bangkim hihtheipa, tunglam van vualzawlnate, nuailam a om gige tui thuktak vualzawlnate, nawite leh sul vualzawlnate, nangmah hon vualzawl dingpa ngei hihhat in na om hi.
english: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

paite: Na pa vualzawlnate hon suangtute vualzawlna sang in tangtawn mualte tawpkhawk pha in athupizawta hi. Hiaite Joseph lutung ah a-om ding a, asanggamte a kipan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah a-om ding hi.
english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

paite: "Benjamin ngia duhgawl bang in, zingsang in asa matte ane ding a, nitaklam in agallak ahawm ding," achi hi.
english: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the spoil.”

paite: Huaite tengteng Israel nam sawm-le-nihte ahi uh. Huai thute leng amaute vualzawlna akiang ua apa uh thugen ahi. Vualzawlna atan ding gun bang zel un avualzawl chiat hi.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.

paite: Ama'n atapate thugou asiah a, akiang uah, "Ka chipihte kiang a pi a om ding ka hita. Hit mi Ephron lou a kokhuk a kei hon suangtute kiang ah hon vui un.
heading: Jakob Sihna Leh Vuina
english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

paite: Kanaan gam a Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh alei ah.
english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

paite: Huai ah Abraham leh azi Sarah avui ua; huai ah Isak leh azi Rebekah avui ua; huai mah ah Leah ka vui hi.
english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

paite: Alou leh asung a kokhuk om Hit suante a kipan alei ahi,” achi hi.
english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

paite: Jakob in atapate kiang a thugou asiah khit in akhete lupna ah angatou a, akha akhahta a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-om samta hi.
english: When Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.
